svg.title: Held-out accuracy during training on modular division
svg.desc: Two panels, regularising either the attention or the MLP at the equals token. Each line averages eight seeds, with a shaded band of one standard deviation: ANNA solid, the UFO dashed, weight decay alone dotted. Median steps to grok: attention, ANNA 16,000 and UFO 15,500; MLP, ANNA 37,500 and UFO 30,000; weight decay alone 104,500.
